business.description: DAM Capital Advisors Limited is a leading Indian full-service investment bank delivering an integrated suite of capital market solutions and advisory services spanning equity capital markets, institutional equities, mergers & acquisitions, private equity advisory and structured finance. The company operates an asset-light, debt-free model with minimal capital requirements supporting high operational efficiency, low capital risk and high return on equity through the cycle.

outlook.statement: India is entering the golden period for its capital markets. Strong domestic fundamentals, sustained public and private investment, favourable demographics, rising entrepreneurial ambition, changing ownership structures and the increasing financialisation of household savings are transforming the country's capital markets and economy. The opportunity before India's investment banking industry is not cyclical but structural, extending well beyond the current market environment and a few quarters.

We enter FY27 with 25 IPO mandates, including 13 where we are the left lead banker and 6 where we are the sole banker, alongside a healthy pipeline of Qualified Institutional Placements and advisory mandates.
The Company increased focus on select, high-quality transactions and sharpened emphasis on fee-accretive mandates across ECM and advisory businesses in response to market volatility.

As of March 31, 2026, secured mandates for 25 IPOs with 14 DRHPs filed with SEBI, representing 7.5% market share of filed IPOs; pipeline includes 13 assignments as left lead banker, of which 6 are sole mandates.

Investment Banking will continue to remain the cornerstone of our franchise, complemented by our Institutional Equities and Advisory businesses, allowing us to support clients through their growth journey. At the same time, we are evaluating complementary fee-based businesses that can diversify our earnings profile and strengthen the resilience of our business.

The Company expects these initiatives, coupled with improved market conditions and greater operating leverage, to result in enhanced productivity, revenue growth, and improved profitability in the coming financial years.

Favourable developments in domestic and global capital markets, increased investor participation, growth in fund-raising activities, and an improvement in overall market sentiment are expected to positively impact the Company's Merchant Banking and Institutional Equities businesses, thereby supporting revenue growth and profitability.
